description: Fetch the currently rendered Reviews for a public Product Hunt product by slug. Compact output returns product review cards and product review metadata; detailed mode adds review tags, raw card text, and nested review-page comments and threads. Verified filter values are all, founder, and informative. The command intentionally does not expose an unverified page or limit parameter.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Required Product Hunt product slug, such as linear or jupitrr.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Verified Reviews view: all, founder, or informative.

parameters.name: detailed
parameters.description: Add review pros/cons, raw card text, and nested review-page comments and threads. Pass true or false.
